apiBoundary: OCC controllers (commercewebservices) delegate to *Facade beans; business logic lives in the ServiceLayer (*Service/*Strategy/DAO), never in controllers — see the repo CLAUDE.md

build.TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE: ./gradlew yupdatesystem   # run with the server STOPPED
build.UNIT_TEST: cd hybris/bin/platform && . ./setantenv.sh && ant build && ant unittests -Dtestclasses.extensions=<ext>   # stop the server first; 'ant build' first so a newly-added test class is registered on the ant runner (a bare gradle ybuild leaves it off → 'No tests found' false pass); the gradle passthrough drops -D and runs the whole platform suite
build.INTEGRATION_TEST: cd hybris/bin/platform && . ./setantenv.sh && ant build && ant integrationtests -Dtestclasses.extensions=<ext>   # server stopped; 'ant build' first (register new test classes); re-run 'ant yunitinit' after any *-items.xml change

HAC (https://localhost:9002/hac) — ImpEx console, FlexibleSearch console, type-system update log

sliceExample: Slice 1: *-items.xml type + service interface/stub + unit test (BUILD, TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE, UNIT_TEST). Slice 2: business logic in the ServiceLayer + any impex data (BUILD, UNIT_TEST, IMPEX_IMPORT). Slice 3: *-beans.xml DTO + OCC endpoint + integration test (BUILD, SERVER_RESTART, INTEGRATION_TEST).

_notes: Starter profile for an SAP Commerce (Hybris) CCv2 backend driven by the gradle wrapper. Set <ext> to your custom extension(s) after install.

Building with raw ant instead? Use the sap-commerce-ant profile — it is a full ant verb table (setantenv sourcing, clean/build/all, server target, yunitinit, hybrisserver.sh control, addon install), not a swap list. Ant is the more common setup.

Note this profile is gradle-for-build, ant-for-tests on purpose: ./gradlew yunittests/yintegrationtests drop -D flags, so the test verbs use the ant form directly. If there is no core-customize/ wrapper directory, set workingDir to 'hybris'.
Always 'yclean' before 'ybuild' — incremental Java compilation is unreliable here and can leave stale .class files on a green build.

Run TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE and all tests with the server STOPPED: yupdatesystem needs the server down (a running server makes ant attempt a JMX wrapper restart that fails), and the junit tenant shuts down Solr on 8983, which is shared with the live server.

Run 'ant build' before 'ant unittests'/'ant integrationtests' whenever a test class was added — a bare gradle ybuild leaves it off the ant runner's classpath and the suite reports a false pass with zero tests run. Always read the real test count.

Scope tests to custom extensions only; never run the full platform suite unless asked. Do NOT use ./gradlew yunittests/yintegrationtests with -D flags (the plugin drops them) — use the ant form above.
Never edit gensrc/, platform/, or OOTB modules — override in custom extensions. Use the Spring alias pattern (defaultMyBean -> myBean). OCC Data/WsDTO classes are generated from *-beans.xml.
Pair with the sap-commerce, impex, sap-best-practices, and java-best-practices knowledge skills if this repo carries them.

Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available in your Claude Code session; 'manual' if Jira exists but is unreachable (paste ticket in; updates written paste-ready); 'none' if there is no Jira.
